title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Enable unified Copilot chat experience consistent with Microsoft Copilot (New Chat with Copilot)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces a unified Copilot chat experience that matches Microsoft 365 Copilot's interface and capabilities. Users can now interact with business data, web search results, and AI-powered assistance through a modern chat with features like temporary chat, model switching, agent mode, file uploads, and resizable windows.
key_points: The new chat experience unifies Business Central with Microsoft 365 Copilot, providing a consistent interface across products
Users can find business data using natural language to query customers, vendors, sales orders, and items
Copilot can organize data by grouping records and performing calculations to create analysis tabs
New capabilities include temporary chat, AI model switching, agent mode, image/file uploads, and expandable window size
All Business Central users can access this feature; Microsoft Copilot license holders get additional benefits like Work IQ

quotes.text: Microsoft unified the experience by bringing Microsoft 365 Copilot directly into Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the key improvement - eliminating the custom UI difference and providing consistency with other Microsoft 365 products.

quotes.text: You can now upload images and files.
quotes.why_it_matters: This highlights a new capability that extends the chat's functionality beyond text-only interactions.
